blocks.title: A third of our world has not yet heard the good news of Jesus.
paragraphs: Global Disciples refers to this third of the world as "least-reached". We live in a time where many of these people are within reach of a local church.
Through our simple and effective strategy of training and coaching, believers share the Gospel in their own nations and cultures.
We understand it's impossible to accomplish this mission alone. That's why we partner with hundreds of clusters of churches across Ethiopia and 2,541 clusters globally.

blocks.title: Why we focus on the least-reached
paragraphs: We believe every person should have an opportunity to hear and respond to the Gospel of Jesus Christ. And we live in a time when many of those least-reached with the Good News of Jesus are within reach of a local church.

Rather than sending traditional cross-oceanic missionaries who face language barriers and high costs, we believe the church closest to the least-reached is God's primary instrument for transformation.
blocks.alt: Elderly Ethiopian man with beard and colorful scarf smiling

blocks.title: How we reach the least-reached
paragraphs: We do this by equipping "near-culture" mission workers—those who share the same or a similar culture with those they are working to reach.
We come alongside the local church to train ordinary men and women to share the Gospel, make disciples, and plant churches in their own nations.
blocks.alt: Joyful smiling young Ethiopian girl with headscarf

blocks.title: Equipping Churches for Reproducible Movements
paragraphs: By pairing frontline discipleship with small business development and servant leadership, local fellowships thrive without continuous foreign dependency.
We partner with more than 2,541 clusters of churches in 79 nations to train, send, and sustain workers who establish living fellowships in zero-access communities.
blocks.alt: Community leaders gathering for discipleship training

approachReveal.title: Equipping People to Reach Their Nations.
approachReveal.subtitle: We train leaders living near least-reached communities to multiply disciples.
